scope: Private original-route consent and same-owner native passing intent foundation; native PASS admission remains disabled
finding: Shared PassingContext already uses NativeOrderReceipt implicit [count,-1] plus owner/epoch/generation and no destinations. Actual owners privately captured native command frame, but no full original DrivingRouteReceipt. NativeRouteReceipt unconditionally refused every active passing work, and PassFinish recalled only a waypoint.
implementation: OwnerOrders private record now has7 fields: token,context,handshake deadline,original expiry,serial,native frame,full owner-local route. VERIFY/RESULT/Begin/passive consent compare exact current route; token release removes matching7-field receipt. No native destination added to shared context.

Begin captures original nativeIntent=[full route,owner stamp,token,original expiry] only when it equals the private original route; captures both native task labels. Top-level CanConsent native PASS refusal retained.

NativeRouteReceipt recognises that separate same-owner intent only for exact current group/platform/seats/epoch/generation/token/expiry/route and native tasks/destinations, with no recovery/bypass/corridor overlap. Original identity may survive expiry for cleanup, never new lifetime or motion permission.

The existing exact CommandWriting marker permits own STOP identity during atomic path acquisition. It does not admit a changed MOVE/action or an unbound stop; ordinary observations still require exact current command frame.
Finish selects original captured native goal when its owned route is native, otherwise unchanged authored waypoint. Existing finite STOP/rest and both-seat return observer remain.
remaining: Native PASS remains refused by DrivingPassCanConsent. Cross-owner cleanup must recognise exact native source original route at the real edge and rebind cleanup intent to current owner without fabricating a goal or adopting executable path. Current inherited helper requires unchanged route comparison and cannot yet identify foreign native temporary-path provenance.
Only after native handover/cleanup integration review may the PASS-specific refusal be removed; QUEUE support is separate and already default-off.

Actual native fixed-path STOP semantics, same-owner and inherited goal return, both operating actors, original-route travel, cancellation/new mission intent and overhead require physical normal/HC validation while audits paused.
limits: Unsigned dirty development snapshot retaining unrelated dirt; engineering notes afterward. Same-owner identity is not controller liveness, consent for new movement, whole-HBQ parity, physical behaviour acceptance or score renewal.
